intro.text: A lighteyed Alethi noblewoman, the daughter of Highprince Aladar, who often accompanies her father to important political meetings.
A lighteyed Alethi noblewoman, the daughter of Highprince Aladar, who commands a group of archers in the defence of Azimir.
A lighteyed Alethi noblewoman, the daughter of Highprince Aladar. She commanded archers in the defence of Azimir and became one of the Unoathed.

items.text: In Urithiru, Highprince Aladar brought May to many important political events. She was invited to Dalinar and Navani Kholin's wedding, and joined Dalinar's diplomatic team in his early efforts to form a coalition, mostly observing and helping Navani gather information arriving by spanreed.

May was present when Torol Sadeas's body was found. After Vedekar Perel's death, her father, now Highprince of Information, had her question Perel's family and associates, and she suggested laws to limit movement around the tower. She also joined scholars and ardents in discussing how Urithiru worked.
When news came of Kholinar's fall, May reacted with extreme nausea.

When Adolin asked Aladar to spare scribes for the defence of Azimir, Aladar sent May. Things were tense at first, since on the Shattered Plains she had thought she and Adolin were dating while he had not. She briefed him on the infirmary, explaining that her ward Rahel was a budding Truthwatcher and that a saferoom lay beneath the site she'd chosen.

To May's surprise, Adolin gave her command of the army's twenty best archers. She excitedly geared up and, during the battle, used a spyglass to protect Adolin by targeting the Heavenly Ones closing in on him, until the Fused turned on her division.

May's wards took over as Adolin's scribes, while May oversaw the messengers and sent Jasnah regular reports on Azimir. Adolin sent her Zabra as a messenger, letting May train her in archery if she did well.

When the spren Notum appeared, May's questions showed real insight into unbonded spren, and she pointedly suggested he ought to form a new Radiant bond. She handed him the messenger corps. Talking with Adolin, she said she was glad they weren't a couple and that he and Shallan suited each other, then told him to get more sleep.

When a thunderclast crushed Adolin's leg, May was there with Rahel, calmly explaining things to him. Another time, guarding him while he played towers with Emperor Yanagawn, she joined a three-way game and told Adolin the Shattered Plains had been lost and Windrunners might not arrive in time.

As the coalition began losing the battle, May and Adolin were sent with pikes to different points on the line. When Yanagawn came looking for Adolin, May, her scribes and Colot went to rescue him, and with a bow she found, she shot a singer about to kill him.

In the saferoom, May drew towers cards on scraps of paper for the emperor. When Skar and Drehy arrived with some squires, Yanagawn and Adolin refused to evacuate, and May backed their plan to sneak into the throne room and volunteered to go.

May led the group through the palace with Yanagawn, straight into a trap. Unexpectedly, the deadeyes Maya had brought back came to their aid, and May became one of the Unoathed as a deadeye manifested as her Plate and Blade. They took and held the throne room, claiming Azir just before the contest of champions settled the borders.

appearance.text: A short, pretty lighteyed Alethi woman in her twenties, with a round face, pale yellow or light tan eyes, and curly jet-black hair worn short.

personality.text: Competent and no-nonsense, May acts and speaks with coolness and precision. She is comfortable pushing the boundaries of what Alethi society deems acceptable for a woman, and, inspired by Jasnah Kholin, is eager to fight on the battlefield herself.
